title: Managed runtime failure and recovery contracts
description: Run deterministic failure injections only when the named QA harness is available; otherwise the case is blocked. The case never treats an unavailable fault hook as a passing mock.

requires.cloudRun: Creates one billable marked pi-chrome service
requires.provider: An existing QA-configured Pi provider for one bounded inert turn; no tools or writes are allowed
requires.faultHarness: A QA-only deterministic harness must be able to inject storage publication failure, writer revocation, uncertain replacement, and no-auto-resume state; absence is blocked
requires.accessRenewal: A QA-only short-lived access fixture is available to prove renewal before expiry; absence is blocked
requires.cleanup: Record exact workspace/session IDs and delete only those IDs after the case

steps.expected: The signed access reconnects the embedded Agent UI without submitting a prompt or changing the active runtime state.
The parent/child access bridge validates origin and source, renews before expiry, and reconnects without reloading the iframe or resubmitting the prompt.
Two identical operation IDs resolve to one session/service and one admitted writer; a second session or writer is a failure.
The injected storage failure leaves the last good checkpoint pointer and reports a safe checkpoint error without empty fallback.
The injected revoked writer receives a safe rejection and cannot publish files, checkpoints, terminal writes, or agent responses.
After injected restore/restart, paused native Goal and conversation state are displayed but no model turn, tool call, or Goal loop starts automatically.
An injected uncertain deletion or replacement does not authorize a successor runner until old-service deletion and generation handoff are confirmed.
